p0.descriptionHtml:
Water feed kit for the Raimondi Power Raizor grinder jig. A fine spray onto the blade kills the dust completely, and a wet blade cuts porcelain faster and leaves a cleaner edge than dry cutting, so you get a better mitre and a cleaner house in one go.

Use it for

  • Wet cutting slabs indoors with the Power Raizor, Power Raizor MkII or BC45
  • Mitres and straight cuts at 45 and 90 degrees

Features

  • Adjustable tap and spray nozzle for good cooling with minimal water
  • Works in any cutting position
  • 8 litre carry tank with relief valve

Compatible with

  • Raimondi Power Raizor (original), Power Raizor MkII and BC45 mitre device

Specifications

  • Tank: 8 litres
  • Model: 433PWW A

Good to know

  • The grinder must be cordless or rated IP54 or better for wet use.
  • Pump the tank up and crack the tap just enough to wet the blade. Too much water only makes slurry.
  • Rinse the nozzle after each job so it does not block with porcelain dust.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Dust containment hood for the Raimondi Power Raizor grinder jig. It closes in the blade and connects to your dust extractor, so dry cutting porcelain slabs indoors no longer fills the room with silica dust. It adjusts to the slab thickness and works for both 45 degree mitres and 90 degree straight cuts.

Use it for

  • Dry cutting slabs indoors or in occupied homes
  • Mitre and straight cuts where you cannot run water

Features

  • Adjusts to the slab thickness
  • Works at 45 and 90 degrees
  • Fits any angle grinder mounted in the Power Raizor

Compatible with

  • Raimondi Power Raizor (original) and Power Raizor MkII
  • A dust extractor with a suitable hose

Specifications

  • Model: 433PWZP A

Good to know

  • Use an extractor rated for fine dust. A domestic vacuum will clog in minutes on porcelain.
  • For zero dust and a faster cut, the water fed kit is the other option, with a cordless or IP54 grinder.
  • Empty the hood of chips before you move to the next cut.

p2.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi snapping pliers for thin porcelain panels from 3 to 6 mm thick. Thin slabs crack where they like if you snap them by hand, so these pliers put progressive pressure exactly on the score line with a turn of the knob, and the break runs true. They are compact and light enough to live in the Raizor bag.

Use it for

  • Snapping scored 3 to 6 mm porcelain panels and slabs
  • Finishing cuts from a Raizor rail cutter or scoring guide

Features

  • Knob applies progressive, precise pressure right on the score line
  • Width adjustable rubber feet to suit the tile and maximise leverage
  • Designed to protect the slab surface

Specifications

  • Tile thickness: 3 to 6 mm
  • Model: 169TR01A
  • Weight: about 330 g

Good to know

  • For 3 to 12 mm panels use the Snap pliers, for 3 to 15 mm the Premium pliers, and for 6 to 20 mm the large Freecut pliers.
  • Support both sides of the score when you snap so the offcut cannot drop and chip the edge.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi heavy duty snapping pliers for tiles and slabs from 6 to 20 mm thick, made from sturdy galvanised steel. Thick porcelain and 20 mm pavers take real force to snap, and these pliers apply it in a controlled way: turn the knob and the pressure builds right on the score line until the tile breaks clean.

Use it for

  • Snapping scored 20 mm outdoor pavers and thick slabs
  • Finishing cuts from a Raizor rail cutter on material too thick for the standard pliers

Features

  • Knob applies progressive, precise pressure right on the score line
  • Width adjustable rubber feet to suit the tile and maximise leverage
  • Dual position rotating presser and breaker for use at the start or end of a cut, or along a strip parallel to the score

Specifications

  • Tile thickness: 6 to 20 mm
  • Galvanised steel
  • Model: 169TM01AN
  • Weight: about 1.2 kg

Good to know

  • These are the pliers Raimondi recommends for tiles over 12 mm on the Raizor MkII and over 15 mm on the MkII Plus and MTC2X.
  • Score 20 mm pavers with firm, even pressure in one pass before snapping.

p4.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi Easymove carrying bars with four RV175 vacuum suction cups, for two people to lift and lay large format tiles. The RV175 cups are pumped up by hand and hold a vacuum you can read on the gauge, so they grip textured and structured porcelain that a plain lever cup would slide off, and the bars give both carriers a proper handhold.

Use it for

  • Carrying and placing large format tiles and panels, smooth or textured
  • Lifting tiles out of the crate and onto the adhesive

Features

  • Four RV175 vacuum suction cups with vacuum gauge
  • Stain free, replaceable rubber pads
  • Die cast aluminium cup bodies on aluminium carrying bars

Specifications

  • Suction cups: 4 x RV175, 175 mm diameter
  • Raimondi rates its four cup RV175 Easy-Move bars for tiles up to 150 cm

Good to know

  • Wipe dust off the tile before you pump the cups, and check the gauge before you lift.
  • For slabs up to 320 cm, the six cup set and the full Easy-Move frame are the step up.
  • Spare rubber pads for the RV175 cups are available.

p5.descriptionHtml:
Raimondi Easymove carrying bars with six RV175 vacuum suction cups, for lifting and laying the largest porcelain slabs. Six cups spread the grip along a 3 metre panel so it does not flex and crack in the middle, and because the RV175 is a pumped vacuum cup with a gauge, it holds on textured and structured slabs as well as polished ones.

Use it for

  • Carrying and placing full size porcelain slabs, smooth or textured
  • Lifting slabs out of the crate and onto the wall or floor with two people

Features

  • Six RV175 vacuum suction cups with vacuum gauge
  • Stain free, replaceable rubber pads
  • Die cast aluminium cup bodies on aluminium carrying bars

Specifications

  • Suction cups: 6 x RV175, 175 mm diameter

Good to know

  • Wipe dust off the slab before you pump the cups, and check every gauge before you lift. Re-pump any cup that drops.
  • Keep the slab vertical while you carry it and only lay it flat on the bed.
  • For tiles up to 150 cm the four cup set is lighter and quicker to set up.

p6.descriptionHtml:
Set of 20 Raimondi support cylinders for the aluminium profile work benches. They slot along the profiles and lift the tile or slab 56 mm clear of the worktop, so you can run an angle grinder right through the material without touching the bench, and get your fingers under the slab to lift it afterwards.

Fits

  • Raimondi BM 180 and BM 180 Plus work benches
  • Raimondi Bigfoot M, XL and XXL benches (Raimondi lists the kit as Art. 394CC 01A)

Specifications

  • Quantity: 20 cylinders
  • Size: 56 mm high x 60 mm diameter
  • Material: polypropylene

Good to know

  • Space the cylinders along both sides of the cut line so the offcut is supported and does not drop and chip.
  • They also give clearance under a slab for the Raizor pliers and for suction cups when you lift it off.
  • Rinse grinder dust off them so the slab sits flat.

p7.descriptionHtml:
The Raimondi CAM Advanced is a trolley for moving large format porcelain slabs around a site without a crew of four. Slabs stand upright on it, so a 320 x 160 cm panel rolls through the house on its edge, and it doubles as a stand: hang the slab on it, still on the carrying frame, and back butter the whole face standing up before you lay it.

Use it for

  • Moving slabs from the crate to the room they are being laid in
  • Holding a slab upright for back buttering
  • Storing a few slabs on edge on site

Features

  • Lightweight build
  • Breaks down quickly for transport
  • Holds the slab while it is still on the Easy-Move carrying frame

Specifications

  • Maximum load: 250 kg
  • Raimondi's example slab for the CAM range is 320 x 160 cm

Good to know

  • Push it on smooth floors. Loose gravel and sand stop the castors.
  • Raimondi has since updated the CAM (MkIII and MkIV, 20.4 kg), still rated at 250 kg.
  • Pair it with the Easy-Move frame or RV175 cups to lift the slab on and off.
